text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before her Debut race, Mejiro Ardan 
pushed herself to the absolute brink. Her 
demeanor could only be described as truly 
demonic in intensity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the day of her debut race arrived. 
Mejiro Ardan headed into the race with 
tremendous focus.
